title: Expiry, Redemption and Deletion Timeline of Domain Registrations
content:
## Registry lifecycle schedule — what happens after expiry to Domain Registrations

| Stage | Starts | Ends |
|---|---|---|
| grace | the day after the expiry date, for a domain whose expiry date passed without renewal | the last day of the TLD's renewal grace days |
| redemption | the day following the last grace day, if not renewed; that day is recorded as the redemption date | the last day of the TLD's redemption days |
| pending delete | the day following the last redemption day, if not restored | purge after the TLD's pending delete days |
| deleted | the purge | — |

**Schedule clauses.**

1. A domain whose expiry date has passed without renewal moves to grace on the day after the expiry date.
2. A domain in grace that is not renewed by the last day of the TLD's renewal grace days moves to redemption on the following day, and that day is recorded as its redemption date.
3. A domain in redemption that is not restored by the last day of the TLD's redemption days moves to pending delete on the following day and is purged after the TLD's pending delete days.
4. Renewal reminders are emailed on each of the TLD's reminder days before expiry, and a post-expiry notice is sent within the TLD's post-expiry notice days after the expiry date. A reminder is skipped when the domain has already been renewed past that expiry, and notices are sent whether or not auto-renew is on.
5. Expiry, redemption and deletion follow the recorded dates alone, and a customer's statement that they meant to renew does not change them.

### Hypothetical timeline (invented dates, 30-day grace, 30-day redemption)

Expiry date 12 January 2029: grace from 13 January; grace days run through 11 February; redemption from 12 February 2029, recorded as the redemption date; redemption days run through 14 March 2029; pending delete from 15 March 2029.

### Basis

Every transition follows the dates on the domain's system record (expiry date, redemption date); no statement of intent moves them.
